dispatch: Two families in the synthesized-widget-border cohort, each carrying one recorded failed obligation named CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP, both re-measured today as EVERY_STROKE_IS_THE_FORMS_OWN_SOME_WITH_ITS_BACKGROUND_FILL_STRIPPED. Read the delivered PDFs and repair what actually clips or overlaps; do not remove border ink on either.

howTheSourceWasRendered.why: A removed-dark-pixel count taken against an ANNOTATION-FREE render of an AcroForm source is worthless: the court keeps a great deal of what it prints inside widget /AP /N streams, so both sides come up blank in the same places and the difference is zero by construction.
howTheSourceWasRendered.renderer: poppler pdftoppm -r 600 -gray -png, which draws widget annotations and applies ISO 32000-1 12.5.5. No flag suppressing annotations was passed.
howTheSourceWasRendered.provedNotAssumed: The same command was run over the pinned JDF-641 and over a control copy of it with every page /Annots and the /AcroForm removed. JDF-641 page 5 renders 725,313 dark pixels normally and 521,645 with annotations removed, so 210,820 dark pixels on that page are drawn by annotations alone. Inside the /Rect of field 11.1 [147.6 488.654 540 553.334], whose /AP /N is `q 0 G 0.5 0.5 395 63.6794 re s Q`, the normal render carries 60,688 dark pixels and the annotation-free control carries 0. The court's writing box at 11.1 exists only inside that widget appearance, and this render draws it.
howTheSourceWasRendered.controlCopyBuiltBy: pdf-lib, page /Annots deleted and /AcroForm dropped; used only as a control and never as a comparison baseline.

sharedModuleChanges: none. No file under scripts/rcap-official-forms/, scripts/rcap-packet-completeness/ or scripts/grade-a-packet-factory-24h/ was modified by this lane. Both repairs are options passed at one caller's own finalizeOfficialForm call site, and both default to false in the shared module.
centralArtifactsEdited: none. MASTER_QUEUE.json, RASTER_QUEUE.json, claim-ledger.json and BORDER_COHORT_REMEDIATION.json were read and not written.
verdictSet: none. This lane repairs and measures; it issues no PASS and sets no verdict, and a repair author does not verify their own candidate.

whatWasWrong.class: ink this packet UNCOVERED -- the court's own opaque white mask stripped out of nine check-box appearances
whatWasWrong.widgets: nine selection rects: four on packet page 1 (JDF-641 p1), four on packet page 2 (JDF-641 p2), one on packet page 7 (JDF-642 p2). The page-1 and page-2 four are the District/County Court, Municipal Court, Prosecuting Attorney and Colorado Bureau of Investigation service boxes; the page-7 one is the order's own election box.
whatWasWrong.cause: Every check box on JDF-641 and JDF-642 ships four appearance streams. /AP /N /Off and /AP /N /Yes open `1 g <bbox> re f`, an opaque WHITE background; /AP /D /Off and /AP /D /Yes open `0.749023 g` or `0.75293 g`. The grey pair is the mouse-DOWN appearance and never prints. stripOpaqueBackgroundPaint in scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-active-content.mjs removes a leading fill at grey >= 0.9 covering the widget, so it took the white /N background and correctly left the grey /D alone. Colorado's own page content prints a smaller box at each of those rects; the /AP covered it with the white fill and stroked a larger one in its place. With the fill gone the printed box was revealed and the stroked box was still drawn, so the participant was handed TWO CONCENTRIC FRAMES at every one of the nine.
whatWasWrong.readOnThePage: Rendered at 300 dpi and read: the pinned source shows one clean box at each control; the delivered packet before this repair shows a second outline inside every one; the delivered packet after it shows one clean box again, matching the source.
whatWasWrong.remedy: RESTORE -- preserveUnwrittenSelectionBackgrounds passed at this builder's own finalizeOfficialForm call. It keeps the source's authored blank-state paint on a selection this run did not write. /MK /BG is still removed, so no background the form did not itself author is requested, no mark is added and no box is ticked.
whatWasWrong.whyNotRemoval: The ledger label on this family until today was SYNTHESIZED_INK_CONFIRMED, whose remedy REMOVES. Deleting this ink would have deleted the Colorado Judicial Department's own check-box stroke from the service and election controls of a motion and a proposed order.
